name: PIE_bench
description: PIE_bench is a Meituan-hosted benchmark collection intended for evaluating instruction-following/generation performance of language models across a range of short-form tasks and prompts. It contains prompt–response pairs designed to test response relevance, correctness, and fluency, and is used for both automatic and human evaluation of model outputs.
reputation: A company-released dataset on Hugging Face with modest visibility; used primarily by researchers experimenting with instruction tuning and evaluation.
